description: P6 field-mapping §2.2 / X03 / §5.4: an explicit symbol measurement rule (U). Declares the reference design canvas, the scale function and its floor. The baseline preset (2381x1684, floor 1.0, min-ratio-floor) is an explicitly adopted design preset, NOT an implicit universal constant for every Style or backend. A physical-symbol mode is a separate explicit design choice, not reverse-engineered from a render result.
